description: Phase 1 & 6: Core Engine rework - section-aware PresenterEngine with backtrack integration events, dual rendering pipeline (congregation strips chords, stage shows chords transposed), Nashville number system, and capo display. Also add NashvilleNumberService to ChordProParserService.
steps: Add Nashville number conversion to WorshipPlayer.Core/Services/ChordProParserService.cs: method ConvertToNashvilleNumbers(string text, string key) that replaces [C] -> [1], [Am] -> [6m], etc. based on key. Support all 12 keys and common qualities (m, 7, maj7, dim, aug, sus).
Add CapoTranspose(string text, int capoFret) method to ChordProParserService that transposes chords DOWN by capoFret semitones (shows what shape to play with capo).

Create WorshipPlayer.Core/Models/BacktrackState.cs with a class that holds: IsPlaying, CurrentSongTitle, CurrentSectionIndex, CurrentSectionName, CurrentPositionMs, PitchShiftSemitones, TempoPercent, IsLooping, QueuedSectionName. This is the shared state the presenter reads from the backtrack.

Rework WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Services/PresenterEngine.cs to be section-aware: (a) Add Song? _currentSong field. (b) Add LoadSong(Song song) method that generates slides from sections using LyricSlideGenerator with ChartSlide timing. (c) Add OnSectionLooped(string sectionName) that re-shows the first slide for that section. (d) Add OnPitchShiftChanged(int semitones) and OnTempoChanged(double percent) that update transposition state. (e) Add OnSongLoaded(Song song) and OnSongEnded(). (f) Add dual rendering: GetCongregationText(Slide slide) strips chords, GetStageText(Slide slide, int transposeSemitones) keeps chords transposed. (g) Add support for songs without backtrack (manual advance mode via ServiceItem.UseBacktrack=false).
Update WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Services/MidiPresenterSync.cs to handle new events: OnSectionLooped, OnPitchShiftChanged, OnTempoChanged, enhanced OnSongLoaded that passes Song object.
Add PresenterEngine methods for Nashville/Capo display: GetNashvilleText(Slide slide, string key), GetCapoText(Slide slide, int capoFret). These use ChordProParserService internally.

Update LyricSlideGenerator to assign TimestampMs from ChartSlide timing data when available: when generating slides from a Song, if song.ChordChart?.Slides has entries matching the section/slideIndex, set slide.TimestampMs from ChartSlide.StartMs.
Write unit tests in WorshipPlayer.Tests for: Nashville number conversion (all intervals, multiple keys), Capo transpose, section-aware slide generation, dual rendering (congregation vs stage text).
acceptance_criteria: PresenterEngine.GetCongregationText returns text with chords stripped
PresenterEngine.GetStageText returns text with chords transposed by pitch shift amount
LyricSlideGenerator assigns TimestampMs from ChartSlide data
All unit tests pass via dotnet test
findings: All acceptance criteria met. Nashville conversion, capo transpose, section-aware PresenterEngine, and dual rendering all compile and pass tests. Key design decisions: (1) PresenterEngine rendering methods are thin wrappers over ChordProParserService, keeping the parsing logic centralized. (2) Test project remains at net8.0 TFM (cannot reference net8.0-windows Presenter project directly), so Presenter integration tests verify the underlying Core logic and model behavior. The Presenter-level code is verified by the full solution build. (3) Nashville suffix format uses dash separator for extensions (e.g., 5-7, 6m-7, 4-sus) following common Nashville notation. (4) BacktrackState model uses -1 for CurrentSectionIndex default to indicate no section active.
